1704-2757-4493-7694.notablePrerequisites: This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. It may take significantly more or less mana than the amount shown. See the widget below for calculations.
1704-2757-4493-7694.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an untapped creature you control, untapping a basic land.
Activate that basic land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Repeat until there are no more available creatures to tap.
Cast Multiversal Incursion by paying its mana cost, targeting Krark.
When you cast Multiversal Incursion, Krark and any additional copies of Krark trigger.
Resolve all Krark triggers, copying Multiversal Incursion for each flip you won, and returning the original to your hand as long as you lost at least one flip.
Resolve each copy of Multiversal Incursion, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Krark each time.
If Multiversal Incursion is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
If you won every flip, instead resolve the Multiversal Incursion card itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the card into your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 9 with Irenicus's Vile Duplication, if you still need more Krark copies.
If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before both Multiversal Incursion and Irenicus's Vile Duplication end up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.

1018-4826-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Skullwinder and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Skullwinder and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
1018-4826-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Skullwinder and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
